card.name: Linking words in indication and age-range phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of" after "reduce the risk" or "at risk", and "to" in age ranges like "6 Years to 17 Years". It fires in dosing and indication sections of drug labels.

modes.label: Risk reduction phrasing
modes.description: The word "of" after "risk" in indication statements about reducing the risk of an outcome.
modes.example: To reduce the risk<< of>> hHF in patients with type 2

modes.label: Pediatric age ranges
modes.description: The word "to" between two ages in a pediatric dosing heading.
modes.example: Dosage in Pediatric Patients 6 Years<< to>> 17 Years of Age

card.writes: It promotes the word "panel" and its variants, which looks like a weak or indirect output effect.
card.plain: It marks small joining words in phrases like "reduce the risk of" and "6 years to 17 years" in label dosing and indication text.
